critical_code_review_comments: RecipeDetail.jsx lines 105/107 used a stray identifier `i` (undeclared) after the :idx→:id refactor — the component threw ReferenceError on every recipe open, effectively breaking the primary recipe flow. This is a Sev-1 leftover; recommend adding a lint rule (`no-undef` enforced) to CI so this class of refactor bug is caught.
LLMBudgetError implementation is clean — subclassing HTTPException means FastAPI serialises it directly and the `except HTTPException: raise` line correctly lets it bypass the generic handler.

Keyword-matching on lowercased str(exception) for 'budget'/'insufficient'/'quota' is heuristic; if the upstream provider ever renames the error string this silently falls back to 500. Consider also matching on HTTP status if the SDK exposes it, or wrapping known SDK exception types.

rca of the issue: USER-REPORTED SYMPTOM: '/inspire took a very long time to load or said 0 options'. ROOT CAUSE (backend, already fixed by main agent before this iteration): the Emergent Universal Key had hit its $4 budget cap so LlmChat.stream_message raised an SDK-level exception whose repr contained 'budget exhausted'; the endpoint's generic `except Exception → HTTPException(500, 'Inspiration failed')` masked the real reason. The 500 came back in <1s so the toast flashed briefly and the empty grid was left showing '0 breakfast ideas' — exactly what the user saw. FIX (main agent): added LLMBudgetError(HTTPException, 503) with a user-friendly detail; wrapped _run_chat with a keyword check on str(e).lower(); added `except HTTPException: raise` in front of each generic handler so the 503 escapes the endpoint unchanged. FRONTEND FIX (main agent): InspireMe.jsx now captures the error into state and renders a friendly card with a Try-again button when results are empty. SECONDARY BUG I FOUND: during the same iteration the :idx→:id route refactor left behind `i` references in RecipeDetail.jsx (lines 105, 107) — every recipe click threw ReferenceError, showing the CRA red overlay. Reproduced by opening any recipe from /inspire. Fixed by hard-coding index 0 (image seed already uses recipe.id/title hash, so index only affects fallback rotation).
